questions.q: According to the text, what is the best approach to developing a leadership style?
a: Find a style that feels natural to you
Copy the style of a famous leader
Adopt a severe and rule-based approach
Match the style of your role model exactly
questions.why: Lesson on authenticity states it is best to find a leadership style of your own.

questions.q: What does the text say about financial incentives for motivating a team?
a: They work but people need more once basic needs are met
They are the only effective method for motivation
They should be avoided to maintain team unity
They are less effective than setting a common goal
questions.why: Lesson on common goals notes financial incentives work but people need more after basic needs.

questions.q: What does the text identify as a distinctive characteristic of a leader?
a: Empathy
Delegation
Severity
Outgoing personality
questions.why: Lesson on listening identifies empathy as a distinctive characteristic of a leader.

questions.q: According to the text, what should a leader do first to inspire their team?
a: Establish the team's purpose and how to achieve it
Offer financial rewards to boost morale
Delegate tasks to build trust
Listen to every team member's opinion
questions.why: Lesson on common goals says the first thing a leader should do is establish purpose.

questions.q: What does the text recommend a leader do to become more open-minded?
a: Proactively encourage the team to bring problems and suggestions
Wait for team members to approach them on their own
Make all decisions independently to show confidence
Only listen when a crisis occurs
questions.why: Lesson on listening recommends proactively encouraging the team to bring problems.
